modules.name: MapPack - Earth
modules.subtitle: Adds additional custom maps
modules.description:
CustomWorld5
A huge map initially generated with Cephalo's PerfectWorld3 map script and heavily edited by Batrach. Features continents, randomized resources, and randomized goodies.

Arakis
A custom map based on a map of Arakis, filled with spice and additional gameplay changes.

By Maruska.

modules.name: Tweak - Units
modules.subtitle: Rebalances units and their resource requirements
modules.description:
PARATROOPER
- Movement reduced to 1
- No longer receives free pillaging movement

XCOM SQUAD
- Extended Paradrop range increased to 20

HELICOPTER GUNSHIP
- Gains Hit-and-Run Doctrine
- +20% Combat Strength when attacking
- -33% Combat Strength when defending
- Can move after attacking
- Requires 1 Oil and 1 Aluminum

NUCLEAR WEAPONS
Atomic Bomb
- Can no longer be purchased with Gold

Nuclear Missile
- Can no longer be purchased with Gold

LAND UNIT RESOURCES
Cannon
- 1 Iron

Artillery
- 1 Iron

Rocket Artillery
- 1 Aluminum

Landship
- 1 Oil + 1 Iron

Tank
- 1 Oil + 1 Iron

Modern Armor
- 1 Oil + 1 Aluminum

NAVAL UNIT RESOURCES
Ironclad
- 1 Coal + 1 Iron

Destroyer
- 1 Oil + 1 Iron

Battleship
- 2 Oil + 1 Iron

Carrier
- 1 Oil + 1 Iron

Submarine
- 1 Oil

Nuclear Submarine
- 1 Uranium

AIR UNIT RESOURCES

- 1 Oil + 1 Iron
